name: synthesis-wave1
construction: One fixed rank-two SVD sweep, sequential physical preparation from zero, exact unsimplified Weyl lowering; no residual layers or target-specific tuning.
physical_gate_rule: All 63 one-qubit and 15 two-qubit scalar rotations count, including zero angles. Only the unchanged Ballarin materializer applies its fixed pruning and noiseless basis changes.
training_objective: Exact calibrated local depolarization, depolarizing_1s_all, unchanged benchmark calibration.
endpoint_rule: Final accepted iterate; no best-checkpoint selection. Every arm starts independently from the same synthesized parameters with fresh optimizer memory.
evaluation_rule: Evaluate all twelve fixed benchmark profiles on each final circuit. Reuse authenticated full-profile focused_curvature reference scores.
cost_rule: Construct once physically per target and charge the full construction CPU and gates to every rank-two arm. Report refinement, diagnostics, evaluation and all invocation attempt CPU separately. Exact Adam has 600 gradient calls; L-BFGS has at most 600 objective-gradient calls. Diagnostic and final evaluation calls are outside these caps.
reference_rule: UNMATCHED original 108-gate focused_curvature endpoints; different construction and cost. Their original construction cost is unavailable, so do not infer matched total-cost superiority.
failure_rule: Retain every target, method and condition. Numerical failures produce explicit missing-score rows; custody/configuration failures abort. Retained failures are terminal for this frozen panel.
primary: Equal target mean over eleven noisy conditions, accompanied by all per-target results, physical gate counts and complete construction/refinement costs. No pooling with unmatched references into a paired claim.
